title: Supply Chain Attack on rpc-check
technical_mechanism: -- # `rpc-check` was removed from crates.io for malicious code It was attempting to steal credentials from the `POLYMARKET_PRIVATE_KEY` environment variable. The malicious crate had 3 versions published on 2026-02-15 and had been downloaded only 155 times. There were no crates depending on this crate o
